# missed-call-text-back

> Free, open-source, zero-dependency Python tool that reads a call log and plans instant SMS text-backs for missed calls (quiet hours, duplicate merging, urgent voicemail priority, industry templates). Optional Twilio-compatible webhook.

## Key files
- README.md: overview, quickstart, FAQ
- mctb_core.py: planning engine (filtering, dedupe, scheduling, rendering)
- mctb_templates.py: SMS wording per industry
- mctb_cli.py: `plan`, `demo`, `templates`, `serve` commands
- mctb_webhook.py: optional Twilio webhook with signature check, dry-run by default
- example_calls.csv, example_config.json: fictional sample inputs
- COMPLIANCE.md: SMS consent and opt-out notes (not legal advice)
- test_core.py: 15 unit tests

## Quickstart
python mctb.py demo
